expectedFailure: H5-B: with a lineHeight below the font ascent, the baseline falls below the line box, outside its link rectangle
note: Found by I14 in the 1,000-document mixed run (9 documents, every one a block link holding a right-to-left or CJK text with lineHeight 1 or 1.2; internals/harness-r1/h5-mixed.md). Reduced form: a CJK text in a PdfLink, lineHeight 1; the baseline is 1.3 pt below the link rectangle. Noto Sans Arabic (ascent about 1.37 em) at 10 pt and lineHeight 1 puts it 3.7 pt below. Likely cause: textkit places the first baseline at the line top plus the font ascent and ignores the half-leading that CSS gives, so a font whose ascent exceeds the line height draws below its box. Helvetica (ascent 0.718 em) never shows it. Not fixed (H5 does not fix engine bugs).
